macros.name: Event Title
macros.description: Becomes the event of the title

macros.name: Event Notes
macros.description: Becomes the content of the notes field

macros.name: Event Organizer
macros.description: Becomes the organizer of the event

macros.name: Attending users of an event
macros.description: A comma seperated list of all people that will be attending the event

macros.name: Tentative users of an event
macros.description: A comma seperated list of all people that will be might be attending the event

macros.name: Unavailable users of an event
macros.description: A comma seperated list of all people that will not be attending the event

macros.name: Group name
macros.description: Becomes the name of the group

macros.name: Event date
macros.description: The date of the event, can be specified to be either the start or end date

parameters.name: p1
parameters.description: Specifies whether the start or end date is required

parameters.name: p2
parameters.description: Specifies the time zone in which the date should be provided

macros.name: Event datetime
macros.description: The datetime of the event, can be specified to be either the start or end datetime

parameters.name: p1
parameters.description: Specifies whether the start or end datetime is required

parameters.name: p2
parameters.description: Specifies the time zone in which the datetime should be provided

macros.name: Event time
macros.description: The time of the event, can be specified to be either the start or end time

parameters.name: p1
parameters.description: Specifies whether the start or end time is required

parameters.name: p2
parameters.description: Specifies the time zone in which the time should be provided
